newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp sees profit hike/wine buys.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp sees profit hike/wine buys.

text.p: Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected higher earnings from each division.
"We see continued profit growth in all of our divisions," Graham Kraehe told the Securities Institute of Australia.
Kraehe said the wine division would achieve double digit profit growth until at least the end of the decade, with profits also set to increase from the appliances and packaging units.

"We are actively looking at other international opportunities", Kraehe said when asked about the outlook for the wine division. He said the focus would be on the North American market, where it is one of the top 10 overseas sellers.
Southcorp achieved a net profit of A$124.22 million in the year to June 30, 1996.
Kraehe, the managing director, told Reuters earlier this month that Southcorp expected to meet analysts forecasts for the current year of A$130 million or more.
Southcorp shares were two cents higher at A$3.71 at 1.35 p.m. (0235 GMT).
